create_video_from_images: create an mp4 video from a list of numpy array images at a given fps
resize_image_to_fit_canvas: resize an image to fit within target width and height while preserving aspect ratio
generate_legend_on_image: generate a color-coded legend grid with labels overlaid on a visualization image
create_disk_mask: create a binary disk mask of a given radius and size for explored area visualization
render_text_to_image: render centered text onto a colored image and return it as a numpy array
